title: thelypteris confluens var. pubescens
intro: Thelypteris confluens var. pubescens, commonly known as the pubescent two-rowed fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris confluens var. pubescens include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
